hypothesis: Training-only repeated exact-over-bin evidence can select the fields where exact identity generalizes, while zero-start gates preserve the PLE fallback.
selector_metric: cross-fitted exact-level smoothed-mean MSE relative to compressed Q-PLE-bin smoothed-mean MSE
cell_gate: qple_support must beat qple and the identical-parameter bin control on validation RMSE, and tple_support must beat tple
architecture_gate: at least two of three cells pass on one development dataset
